summary: This standard covers companies that lend against property, mainly residential and commercial mortgages, and provide mortgage servicing. Disclosure topics are lending practices, discriminatory lending and environmental risk to mortgaged properties.

questions.text: What are (1) the number and (2) the value of your residential mortgages of the following types: (a) combined fixed- and variable-rate, (b) prepayment penalty, and (c) total?
questions.hint: Unit: Number, Presentation currency · Report a count and a value (presentation currency) for each of the three types.

questions.text: What are (1) the number and (2) the value of (a) residential mortgage modifications, (b) foreclosures, and (c) short sales or deeds in lieu of foreclosure?
questions.hint: Unit: Number, Presentation currency · Report a count and a value (presentation currency) for each of the three categories.

questions.text: What was the total amount of monetary losses as a result of legal proceedings associated with communications to customers or remuneration of loan originators?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report the total monetary losses in your presentation currency for the reporting period.

questions.text: How is the remuneration of your mortgage loan originators structured?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe the fixed and variable components, what drives variable pay and safeguards against incentivising harmful lending.

questions.text: What are (1) the number, (2) the value and (3) the weighted average loan-to-value ratio of mortgages issued to (a) minority borrowers and (b) all other borrowers?
questions.hint: Unit: Number, Presentation currency, Percentage (%) · Report each of the three measures separately for minority borrowers and for all other borrowers; value in presentation currency, LTV as a percentage.

questions.text: What was the total amount of monetary losses as a result of legal proceedings associated with discriminatory mortgage lending?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report the total monetary losses in your presentation currency for the reporting period.

questions.text: What policies and procedures does your organisation have for ensuring non-discriminatory mortgage origination?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe the policies, monitoring, training and review processes used to prevent discrimination.

questions.text: What are (1) the number and (2) the value of your mortgage loans in 100-year flood zones?
questions.hint: Unit: Number, Presentation currency · Report a count and a value (presentation currency) of mortgage loans located in 100-year flood zones.

questions.text: What are (1) your total expected loss and (2) Loss Given Default (LGD) attributable to mortgage loan default and delinquency because of weather-related natural catastrophes, by geographical region?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency, Percentage (%) · Report expected loss in your presentation currency and LGD as a percentage, for each region.

questions.text: How are climate change and other environmental risks incorporated into your mortgage origination and underwriting?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe how such risks are assessed, which criteria or models are used and how they influence lending decisions.

questions.text: What are (1) the number and (2) the value of mortgages you originated, by category: (a) residential and (b) commercial?
questions.hint: Unit: Number, Presentation currency · Report a count and a value (presentation currency) for each category.

questions.text: What are (1) the number and (2) the value of mortgages you purchased, by category: (a) residential and (b) commercial?
questions.hint: Unit: Number, Presentation currency · Report a count and a value (presentation currency) for each category.
